using namespace std;

const long long MOD = 998244353LL;
vector<long long> fact;

long long binomial(int n, int r);
long long modInverse(long long a, long long mod);
long long pow(long long base, long long exp, long long mod);

int main() {
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    
    int t = 1;
    while (t-- > 0) {
        int n;
        long long k;
        cin >> n >> k;
        
        fact.resize(n + 1);
        fact[0] = fact[1] = 1LL;
        for (int i = 2; i <= n; i++) {
            fact[i] = (fact[i - 1] * i) % MOD;
        }
        
        if (k == 0) {
            cout << fact[n] << '\n';
        } else if (k >= n) {
            cout << 0 << '\n';
        } else {
            int kVal = (int)k;
            long long sum = 0LL;
            long long sign = 1LL;
            int l = n - kVal;
            
            for (int i = 0; i <= l; i++) {
                long long term = pow(l - i, n, MOD);
                term = (term * binomial(l, l - i)) % MOD;
                term = (term * sign) % MOD;
                sum = (sum + term + MOD) % MOD;
                sign = -sign;
            }
            
            long long ans = (2LL * binomial(n, kVal) % MOD) * sum % MOD;
            cout << ans << '\n';
        }
    }
    
    return 0;
}

long long binomial(int n, int r) {
    if (r < 0 || r > n) return 0LL;
    if (r == 0 || r == n) return 1LL;
    long long denom = (fact[r] * fact[n - r]) % MOD;
    return (fact[n] * modInverse(denom, MOD)) % MOD;
}

long long modInverse(long long a, long long mod) {
    return pow(a, mod - 2, mod);
}

long long pow(long long base, long long exp, long long mod) {
    long long res = 1LL;
    base %= mod;
    while (exp > 0) {
        if ((exp & 1) == 1) {
            res = (res * base) % mod;
        }
        base = (base * base) % mod;
        exp >>= 1;
    }
    return res;
}
